verdict.instructions: What does reaction say about the result of prompt? prompt and answerTail (the last part of the reply) are context only.

criteria.accepted: confirms success or accepts the result
criteria.partial: accepts some, names a remaining gap
criteria.corrected: says it is wrong, asks for a fix

frustration.instructions: How frustrated is the user in reaction?

complaint.instructions: What does the user complain about in reaction?

criteria.wrong_scope: changed too much or too little
criteria.ignored_instruction: an instruction or rule was ignored
criteria.invented_fact_or_api: a fact, file or API was invented

repeats_request.instructions: Does reaction repeat an earlier request?

cites_ignored_instruction.instructions: Does reaction point to an instruction the assistant ignored?

stops_or_reverts.instructions: Does reaction stop the work or ask to revert it?

profanity_or_shouting.instructions: Does reaction contain profanity or shouting (capitals, many exclamation marks)?
